events.title: NextFest Demo Update
events.summary: Chattini Jetpack Project is joining Steam Next Fest!... and together with it, a new 0.2.0 snapshot of the demo! events.title: Demo Available Now!
events.summary: Hey there, little Chattino. Heard you wanted some jetpacks. Well do I have something for you.This lil' factory game right here. Well let's just say you can make your own jetpacks. Out of thin air. With the help of all your friends.Now before you run into walls from excitement: No, not now. The author of the game is still hard at work, fighting with the belt optimizer and rendering bottlenecks. They must really hate jetpacks.Anyway, that doesn't mean we can't give you a little taste of what's to
